explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/654: 'It is trivial that f(n) ≥ (n−1)/3.' The statement proves the stronger pointwise version: every x ∈ A has ≥ (|A|−1)/3 distinct distances, since a circle centred at x holds at most 3 other points when no four are concyclic. Proved in the file. Faithful.
